## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed.

Roadmap ID: (e.g. A2.2, B1, or backlog #12 in `docs/roadmap.md`)

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## How Has This Been Tested?

Mark each check PASS, FAIL or SKIPPED (with the reason).

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` — 0 errors
- [ ] `npm run lint` — 0 errors, no new warnings
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage` — all pass, thresholds met
- [ ] `npm run build` — succeeds
- [ ] `npm run check:bundle` — within budget
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` — Playwright smoke and axe pass
- [ ] Manual check with real files (for tool changes): browsers and file types tried

## Checklist:

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] No hardcoded tools, limits, copy, colors or URLs (`CLAUDE.md` §6a)
- [ ] No `releaseState` change, or the change is approved by the maintainer and in its own commit
- [ ] No new dependency, CSP or `Permissions-Policy` change, or it is approved
- [ ] English and Arabic/RTL considered for any new UI text
- [ ] `docs/roadmap.md` status row and backlog updated
